newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela extends ban on job dismissals 45 days.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela extends ban on job dismissals 45 days.

text.p: The Venezuelan government will extend for another 45 days from May 3 a ban on job dismissals, Labor Minister Maria Bernardoni said.
Admitting the firing ban had not been completely effective, she said the extension was decided because of the high number of "unjustified dismissals" in the private sector in recent weeks.

"The measure was adopted to take into account unjustified dismissals that have occurred during the period covered by the ban," she told reporters at Miraflores presidential palace, after announcing a 44 percent increase in the monthly minimum wage.

The government placed a 45-day ban on dismissals on March 19 while a complex, ground-breaking agreement reached last month on severance pay became law. The Labor Law reforms are being studied by Congress, but President Rafael Caldera conceded on Tuesday that "they have run into delays."
The firing ban followed concern from some sectors that employers might use the intervening period before the implementation of the new severance pay system to fire workers.
